title.en: Keep sending messages in long-running workspaces
title.zh: 长时间打开工作区后仍可正常发送消息

description.en: The desktop app renews your sign-in while a workspace stays open. If your session has expired, it asks you to sign in again instead of leaving you with failed messages.
description.zh: 工作区保持打开时，桌面应用会自动续期登录状态。若登录已过期，会提示重新登录，避免消息持续发送失败。
